verdict_label: Vulgar insult, distinct from the moutza
explanation: Forming a circle with the thumb and index finger (the Western 'OK' sign) carries a vulgar, sexually-charged insult in several Mediterranean countries including Greece and Turkey. It is not the same gesture as the moutza (an open, outstretched palm thrust toward someone), which is Greece's other, unrelated insulting gesture — the two are sometimes mixed up, but they have separate origins and meanings.
local_tip: Don't use the OK hand sign to mean 'all good'; say 'endaxi' (okay) or simply nod and smile instead.
regional_note: Younger, urban Greeks are often aware the sign means something positive internationally, but it is still widely considered rude to make it locally.

also_check.note: The OK sign is a vulgar insult, similarly to Greece.
